memory: The absolute lowest point of the collapse. Being pushed down, falling into the dark, and exhausting every remaining reserve until the old mechanisms of survival completely shatter. The rebuilding cannot begin until the breakdown is complete.
hardHittingLine:
cause they will run you down, down 'til the dark

Yes and they will run you down, down 'til you fall

And they will run you down, down 'til you go

Yeah, so you can't crawl no more
whyThisLine: It captures the exact darkness of the catalyst. Rebuilding doesn't start with hope; it begins at the brutal boundary where your old way of moving forward physically cannot continue.
